title: Garden-governed evolution pipeline
objective: Apply existing Garden/GSL mechanisms to the pipeline that evolves Garden itself, in strict order: typed actions, DesignEpoch binding, authority envelopes, ActionGate routing, config-as-delta, constitutional tier, and Level-2 falsifiability.
required_outputs: Step 1: typed PROPOSE/TRIAGE/TEST/ACCUMULATE/MATERIALIZE action contracts with explicit pre/post conditions
Step 2: DesignEpoch binding for findings, tests, and deltas with stale re-derivation rules
Step 3: bounded agent authority envelopes with no self-minting, delegation expansion, or canonical-promotion authority
Step 4: ActionGate routing and receipts for every evolution action
Step 5: pipeline configuration represented as governed delta objects
Step 6: constitutional tier for gate/envelope/epoch-rule changes with human approval
Step 7: Level-2 falsifiability attacks on Garden governance of its own evolution
acceptance: No throughput scaling, integrator challenger, or findings ledger is activated before Steps 1-4 pass deterministic tests
No code delta lacks a source-obligation/provenance link
No agent can promote canon, mint its own authority, or expand authority through delegation
Published v15.5 remains immutable and successor materialization remains candidate-only until human promotion
